name: Eleazar
overview: Eleazar was a male descendant of Mahli from the tribe of Levi, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 24:28. His heritage places him within the Levitical lineage, which was set apart for priestly duties in Israel. Beyond this genealogical note, no additional personal details are provided.
namesAndTitles: The name Eleazar means 'G-d [El] is a help,' reflecting a recognition of divine assistance. This proper name, as noted in 1 Chronicles 24:28, emphasizes reliance on God but was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Eleazar as a descendant of Mahli, establishing his place within a Levitical family line. No other family relationships are recorded beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Eleazar's significance lies in his identification as a Levitical descendant, which ties him to the priestly heritage essential for Israel's worship and service to God. His mention in 1 Chronicles 24:28 situates him within the organized priestly divisions, underscoring the continuity of God's provision for worship through chosen families.
